callouts.1: Adaptive dynamic potential threshold: the channel mean of x drives a spiking projection whose tanh output Δ shifts a learnable log-threshold θ; the token-mixer input is divided by Vth = e^{θ+Δ} (the S4D internal threshold is switched off).
callouts.2: Branch-specific thresholds: each FFN branch divides its input by its own Vth_i = e^{θ+θ_i+Δ}, so the three spiking pathways can fire at different rates.
callouts.3: New channel-mixer sub-layer (the S4 expert has none): weighted 3-branch spike FFN: main and gate₁ spike trains are summed with learnable scalar weights and multiplied by the gate₂ spike train before the spiking down projection.
callouts.4: Spike forget / update residual: x + y becomes x⊙f + y⊙u, where f and u are binary spikes from a spiking projection of the residual stream.
callouts.5: Spike-gated SSM output + spiking read-out: binary spikes from a gate neuron on the block's scaled input pass or block each SSM output channel, and the read-out is a spiking linear (LIF → W) instead of the expert's Conv1×1 + GLU.
